scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),{execFileSync}=require('child_process');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):e.name.endsWith('.js')?[path.join(d,e.name)]:[]);for(const f of walk('src'))execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('All server files OK');"
